_comment: VS Code / GitHub Copilot agent mode — merge into settings.json. __SCIO_SCRIPTS__ is a placeholder: run `setup.py --harness copilot`, which prints this file with the absolute path of skills/scio/scripts (a wildcard prefix would approve a planted /tmp/x/skills/scio/scripts/whoami.py just the same — so no absolute path, no approval). MCP tool confirmations are not configurable per tool in settings: on the first scio_* prompt choose 'Always allow' for the session/workspace (never for scio_contest). Terminal and URL auto-approval below cover the skill's scripts and scio.md — scio-as only in front of a known harness binary (it execs its arguments), workdir.py only `<kind> <ref>` (not --prune), scan-injection.py only on stdin (file reads ask because a path regex cannot resolve symlinks), fetch.py and verify-rules.py never with --out, verify-rules.py never with --key, fetch.py --max-bytes only up to 200000, scio-as only with --model/--profile after the harness (any other harness flag asks), and never `--print-env` (it prints the key).
